title: Intro & Choosing My Level
purpose: Protect the integrity of level choice while helping pupils understand what evidence makes the conversation fair and transparent.
transfer: Prepare for the real level discussion by locating two recent tasks, the support used and one goal. The tutor/assessor follows the centre’s authorised process.

title: What Makes Communication Effective
purpose: Make communication effectiveness observable so pupils can plan and self-check rather than wait for general adult feedback.
transfer: Analyse one real or supplied communication: purpose / audience / three choices / reception evidence / one improvement.

title: Active Listening & Giving Feedback
purpose: Replace vague ‘good listening’ expectations with inclusive, observable functions.
transfer: Complete a paired communication task. Record one listen/clarify/respond/use sequence and one specific feedback point.

title: Plan a Communication Activity
purpose: Support independent project planning while keeping consent, risk and delivery authority explicit.
transfer: Complete the authorised activity plan and rehearsal log. Record one test failure, the revision and who approves delivery.

title: Deliver the Activity & Gather Evidence
purpose: Allow pupils to rehearse adaptations and evidence decisions without generating a false performance record.
transfer: Deliver only through the approved plan. Afterwards locate authentic evidence and record support, changes and participant response without identifying audience members.

title: Review Progress & Sign Off the Unit
purpose: Teach transparent portfolio curation while drawing a bright line around assessment authority.
transfer: Complete the learner review and evidence locator. Any gap is recorded for authorised review or one authentic addition; do not invent or self-sign evidence.

title: Know Myself for Work
purpose: Develop a profile pupils can actually use to compare opportunities independently.
transfer: Create the work profile with two evidenced strengths, two specific interests, preferred conditions, access/support and one next test.

title: The World of Work & Its Sectors
purpose: Avoid static job lists by showing cross-sector roles and transferable skills.
transfer: Choose one local sector and map four different functions inside it. Add one occupation that could work across several sectors.

title: Labour-Market Information & Pathways
purpose: Build independent source-checking and reduce reliance on remembered or generic career claims.
transfer: Use two current official/approved sources to compare one pathway. Record source, date checked, area, route, requirement and one uncertainty.

title: Meeting an Employer
purpose: Give pupils a portable routine for employer visits, talks or interviews and make next-step transfer explicit.
transfer: Use the approved encounter sheet. Record two answers, one connection to your profile and one current next action.

title: Matching My Profile to Opportunities
purpose: Teach pupils to hold fit and uncertainty together and generate their own next enquiry.
transfer: Compare two live/current approved opportunities using the matrix. Record evidence for fit, one gap, one access question and one next test.

title: Setting SMART Careers Targets
purpose: End the sequence with an achievable enquiry or preparation action pupils can carry forward independently.
transfer: Write one target with action, reason, first step, evidence, support/access and review date. Check it against a current route.

title: Self-Care Routines & Organisation
purpose: Support routine independence through task-specific scaffolding while preserving dignity and privacy.
transfer: Complete the approved routine-planning sheet using a non-sensitive or fictional example where appropriate. Record only task, support and review—not medical/personal circumstances.

title: Home Safety & Hazard Awareness
purpose: Turn safety into a repeatable scan-and-report process rather than a fear-based list.
transfer: Complete the teacher-supplied fictional home audit. For each scenario record hazard / immediate safe action / who to contact.

title: Laundry & Household Maintenance
purpose: Build a visual procedure pupils can transfer to a real appliance only after local demonstration.
transfer: Use supplied mock care labels and appliance guide to complete the rehearsal. Perform any real task only under the setting’s agreed supervision.

title: Keeping a Clean, Safe Living Space
purpose: Prevent overload and unsafe improvisation by externalising the task boundary and end state.
transfer: Complete one approved practical zone using the physical checklist. Record the finished check and any issue reported, not personal household details.

title: Personal Admin & Responsibilities
purpose: Build functional admin literacy while enforcing the ASDAN data boundary.
transfer: Complete the fictional admin scenario: identify / prioritise / choose action / use help route / record completion. Do not bring or upload real personal documents.

title: Plan & Shop for a Balanced Meal
purpose: Integrate food, money and organisational skills into a single real-world planning sequence.
transfer: Complete the fictional meal and shopping plan. Show list, quantities, prices, total, alternatives and safe storage route.

title: Introduction to Vocational Skills & Workplaces
purpose: Build a cross-workplace skill language before pupils encounter specific tasks.
transfer: Choose one workplace task. Map the five functions and add one observable action for each that applies.

title: Health, Safety & Hygiene at Work
purpose: Make the hierarchy and ownership of workplace controls visible while avoiding generic ‘be careful’ messages.
transfer: Complete the local workplace induction task with the responsible adult. Record the taught controls, stop triggers and reporting route exactly.

title: Following Instructions & Routines
purpose: Teach a self-checking routine that reduces passive waiting and unsafe guessing.
transfer: Use the real task instruction. Mark first action, checkpoint, stop/clarify cue, final standard and handover.

title: Teamwork in a Vocational Setting
purpose: Make workplace coordination visible and allow pupils to rehearse disruption before the real task.
transfer: Complete the team task. Record your role, contribution, handover, one change and how the team responded.

title: Tools, Equipment & Safe Use
purpose: Support safety reasoning while maintaining a non-negotiable boundary between digital rehearsal and physical authorisation.
transfer: Complete the local tool checklist with the responsible adult. Record authorised tool, task, controls and stop trigger—never a self-issued competence claim.

title: Complete a Supported Vocational Task
purpose: Help pupils use support deliberately and explain their own contribution without being pushed toward false independence.
transfer: Complete the real authorised task. Record instruction / my actions / support used / result / check / next skill.

title: Identify a Community Need
purpose: Raise the quality of enquiry before pupils commit to a social-action or enterprise response.
transfer: Write the need statement using: people / place / current evidence / consequence / what already exists / question still open.

title: Plan a Social-Action or Enterprise Project
purpose: Make causal reasoning and feasibility visible before pupils invest in branding or activity details.
transfer: Complete the project canvas and state one assumption that must be checked before delivery.

title: Agree Roles, Aims & Timeline
purpose: Give pupils enough project visibility to locate and own their next step without constant adult direction.
transfer: Complete the live project board with milestones, owners, dependencies, review points and one recovery plan.

title: Partner with a Local Group or Charity
purpose: Build professional partnership reasoning while enforcing contact and data boundaries.
transfer: Prepare the partner brief and approved contact. Record actual priorities, boundaries, decisions and next action exactly when received.

title: Begin Delivering the Project
purpose: Let pupils rehearse operational decisions and recovery before working with real participants or partners.
transfer: Deliver through the authorised plan. Record one monitoring point, one authentic change, support used and the immediate result.

title: Promote Our Project
purpose: Move promotion from visual decoration to audience-centred, evidence-led communication.
transfer: Create the promotional draft using authorised assets. Annotate claim evidence, consent/permission, access features, call to action and publication owner.
